'''Biliran's at-large congressional district''' is the sole [[congressional district of the Philippines]] in the province of [[Biliran]]. It was created ahead of the [[1995 Philippine House of Representatives elections]] following its conversion into a regular province under the 1991 Local Government Code (Republic Act No. 7160) which was ratified in a 1992 plebiscite concurrent with [[1992 Philippine general election|that year's general election]].<ref name="ra7160">{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=7160|url=https://www.officialgazette.gov.ph/1991/10/10/republic-act-no-7160/ |title=An Act Providing for a Local Government Code of 1991 |date=October 10, 1991 |publisher=[[Official Gazette (Philippines)|Official Gazette of the Republic of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 13, 2021}}</ref> Biliran had been a [[sub-provinces of the Philippines|sub-province]] of [[Leyte (province)|Leyte]] since 1959 and was last represented as part of [[Leyte's 3rd congressional district|Leyte's 3rd district]] in the [[House of Representatives of the Philippines|House of Representatives]] from 1987 to 1995 and earlier from 1961 to 1972, the multi-member [[Eastern Visayas|Region VIII]]'s at-large district in the [[Interim Batasang Pambansa]] from 1978 to 1984, and the multi-member [[Leyte's at-large congressional district|Leyte's at-large district]] in the [[Regular Batasang Pambansa]] from 1984 to 1986.<ref>{{cite PH act|chamber=RA|number=2141|publisher=Lawyerly|url=https://www.lawphil.net/statutes/repacts/ra1959/ra_2141_1959.html|date=April 8, 1959|title=An Act Creating the Sub-Province of Biliran|author=Arellano Law Foundation|accessdate=March 13, 2021}}{{Dead link|date=January 2026 |bot=InternetArchiveBot }}</ref><ref name="congleg">{{cite web |url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |title=Roster of Philippine legislators |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=March 13, 2021 |archive-date=March 16, 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170316064243/http://congress.gov.ph/legislators/?v=province |url-status=dead }}</ref> It is currently represented in the [[20th Congress of the Philippines|20th Congress]] by [[Gerardo Espina Jr.]] of [[Lakas–CMD]].<ref name="congmem">{{cite web|url=http://www.congress.gov.ph/members/ |title=House Members |publisher=[[House of Representatives of the Philippines]] |accessdate=July 10, 2023}}</ref>
